description: This file defines a function 'myRecipes' that scrapes recipe data from a specific URL on 'myrecipes.com'. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract recipe details such as image, name, ingredients, instructions, time, and servings. The function returns a Promise that resolves with a Recipe object or rejects with an error.

methods.name: myRecipes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and parses a recipe page from 'myrecipes.com' to extract recipe details into a Recipe object.
